_how_to_use: Add places you (Stached), a trusted client (Scouted), or a direct check (Vetted) can vouch for. The name must match what appears in itineraries. Stached: set stached:true for anywhere you've personally been and vouch for — a blog post isn't required. If you HAVE written it up, also add blog_link, the direct URL to that specific post on wanderingmustache.com, never the bare homepage or a category page; travelers see it as an 'Our write-up' link, so it must open the actual write-up. Leave blog_link blank ('') if there's no post — the place still gets the Stached badge, just without a link. Scouted needs client_feedback (positive only). Vetted needs verification_method plus verified_date (phone/email) or rating of 4.5+.
_template: The app only reads the "places" list below, so this line and this template are never shown to a traveler or matched against a trip — copy the shape into "places" when you add a real one.

_example_you_can_copy.name: Name exactly as it should appear in an itinerary
